desc: Parse S into a tree: use a stack to build parent/children structure; each node's children list = sequence of top-level substructures inside it (treat the whole string as children of a virtual root).

Implement canonical subtree hashing (sorted tuple of child class-IDs mapped to fresh IDs via dict — exact, no hash collisions) so two subtrees can be compared for equality in O(1) after O(N log N) preprocessing.
Determine per-node contribution: corrected from palindrome/2-factor to k!/Π mult_X! since sublist reversals generate arbitrary permutations of children at each node.

Prove/verify the independence claim: adjacent-sibling swaps via length-2 sublist op + involution restore ⇒ full symmetric group per node; equivalence classes = unordered-tree isomorphism; reachable sets of distinct classes are disjoint, giving ans(v) = k! · Π ans(c_i) / Π mult_X!.
Implement the full solution in Python with O(N log N) complexity (N ≤ 5000), reading stdin and printing the product mod 998244353.
